properties.displayName: [CredentialAccess] Potential DCSync Attack Detected
properties.description:
A potential DCSync attempt has been detected.
This alert fires when an account performs directory replication operations normally reserved for Domain Controllers.

DCSync attacks simulate a Domain Controller to obtain password hashes using DS-Replication privileges.
properties.query:
IdentityDirectoryEvents
| where ActionType == "DirectoryReplicationGet"
| where AdditionalFields contains 'DS-Replication-Get-Changes-All'
    or AdditionalFields contains 'DS-Replication-Get-Changes'
| project 
    TimeGenerated,
    AccountDisplayName,
    AccountObjectId,
    ActionType,
    AdditionalFields,
    TargetDeviceName,
    DestinationDeviceName,
    DestinationIPAddress
| summarize
    EventCount = count(),
    take_any(AdditionalFields, DestinationDeviceName, DestinationIPAddress, ActionType)
    by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), AccountDisplayName, AccountObjectId, TargetDeviceName
| where EventCount > 0

properties.displayName: [CredentialAccess] Certipy Enumeration Tool Detected
properties.description:
This alert identifies the execution of the Certipy tool, which is commonly used by adversaries to enumerate and exploit
misconfigurations in Active Directory Certificate Services (ADCS). Certipy enables attackers to discover vulnerable certificate
templates, request certificates with elevated privileges, and potentially escalate access or establish persistence within the environment.
properties.query:
// Detect Certipy execution via direct binary or Python module invocation
DeviceProcessEvents
| extend FileNameLower = tolower(FileName)
| where FileNameLower in ("certipy.exe", "certipy.py")
    or (
      FileNameLower in ("python.exe", "python3.exe", "py.exe")
      and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("-m certipy", " certipy ", " certipy.py")
    )
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    DeviceName,
    FileName,
    FolderPath,
    ProcessCommandLine,
    InitiatingProcessAccountName,
    SHA1,
    ReportId

properties.displayName: [CredentialAccess] Admin User has Deleted an MFA phone from a Users Account
properties.description:
An admin user deleted a user's MFA phone method. This may leave the account without MFA protection.
Investigate whether this change was expected (e.g., helpdesk-assisted reset) and confirm the user's MFA posture.
properties.query:
// Detect admin deletion of MFA (phone) methods
AuditLogs
// Activity/Result description patterns for MFA phone removal
| where ActivityDisplayName has "Admin deleted security info"
  and ResultDescription has "Admin deleted phone method for user"
// Capture initiator (app or user); prefer user UPN when available
| extend InitiatedByUserUPN = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName),
         InitiatedByUser    = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.displayName),
         InitiatedByApp     = tostring(InitiatedBy.app.displayName)
| extend InitiatedByActor   = coalesce(InitiatedByUserUPN, InitiatedByUser, InitiatedByApp)
// TargetResources usually contains the affected User object. Expand and extract.
| mv-expand TargetResources
| extend TR = TargetResources
| extend TRType        = tostring(TR.type)
| extend TRDisplayName = tostring(TR.displayName)
| extend TRUPN         = tostring(TR.userPrincipalName)
// Fold per operation/correlation id to one row and extract the affected user
| summarize
    TimeGenerated = max(TimeGenerated),
    TargetUserUPN = anyif(TRUPN, TRType =~ "User"),
    TargetUser    = anyif(TRDisplayName, TRType =~ "User"),
    InitiatedByActor = any(InitiatedByActor),
    Activity      = any(ActivityDisplayName),
    Result        = any(ResultDescription)
  by CorrelationId
// Derive Account entity identifiers for mapping
| extend InitiatedByName = tostring(split(InitiatedByActor, "@")[0]),
         InitiatedByUPNSuffix = iif(indexof(InitiatedByActor, "@") > 0, tostring(split(InitiatedByActor, "@")[1]), ""),
         TargetName = tostring(split(TargetUserUPN, "@")[0]),
         TargetUPNSuffix = iif(indexof(TargetUserUPN, "@") > 0, tostring(split(TargetUserUPN, "@")[1]), "")
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    CorrelationId,
    Activity,
    Result,
    InitiatedByActor,
    InitiatedByUserUPN = InitiatedByActor,
    InitiatedByName,
    InitiatedByUPNSuffix,
    TargetUser,
    TargetUserUPN,
    TargetName,
    TargetUPNSuffix

properties.displayName: [CredentialAccess] Potential Kerberoasting Attack
properties.description:
This alert indicates a potential Kerberoasting attack detected within the environment.
Kerberoasting is a credential theft technique where an attacker requests service account
Kerberos tickets that use weak encryption (such as RC4), then cracks them offline to obtain
plaintext passwords.

Attackers who successfully Kerberoast a service account can gain elevated privileges and move
laterally across the network. Review the affected user, the SPNs involved, and determine
whether the request was legitimate.
properties.query:
let WhitelistAccounts = dynamic(["svc_appviewx@creditsafe.com", "safeservice@creditsafeuk.com"]);
IdentityLogonEvents
| where Protocol == "Kerberos"
// Look for MITRE ATT&CK tag for Kerberoasting (T1558.003)
| extend AttackTechniques = tostring(parse_json(AdditionalFields)["AttackTechniques"])
| where AttackTechniques has "T1558.003"
// Kerberoasting almost always involves RC4 encryption
| extend EncType = tostring(parse_json(AdditionalFields)["EncryptionType"])
| where EncType has "rc4"
// Extract SPNs involved for investigation
| extend SPNs = tostring(parse_json(AdditionalFields)["Spns"])
// Exclude known service accounts
| where AccountUpn !in (WhitelistAccounts)
| where AccountName !contains 'svc_solarwinds_orion'
// Normalized identity fields for entity resolution
| extend AccountNamePart = tostring(split(AccountUpn, "@")[0])
| extend AccountUPNSuffix = iif(indexof(AccountUpn, "@") > 0, tostring(split(AccountUpn, "@")[1]), "")
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    AccountNamePart,
    AccountUPNSuffix,
    AccountUpn,
    SPNs,
    EncType,
    AttackTechniques

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat:
A potential Kerberoasting attack has been identified.

Account: {{AccountUpn}}
Encryption Type: {{EncType}}
SPNs Queried: {{SPNs}}

Kerberoasting allows attackers to request service account tickets encrypted with weak algorithms (e.g., RC4),
then crack them offline to reveal plaintext passwords.

Recommended Actions:
- Investigate the originating system and process
- Confirm whether the account legitimately required Kerberos service tickets
- Audit the service account for weak password usage
- Rotate service account credentials if needed

properties.description:
DO NOT EDIT IN PORTAL - MANAGED VIA GIT REPO.

Detects users retrieving significantly more records from Dynamics 365 than in the past 2 weeks.
This may indicate potentially unauthorized access or bulk extraction of data from Dynamics 365.
properties.query:
let baseline_time = 14d;
let detection_time = 1d;
// Minimum baseline for users with no historical activity (tune as needed)
let defaultBaseline = 100.0;

// Baseline over 14d up to 1d ago
let baseline =
    Dynamics365Activity
    | where TimeGenerated between (ago(baseline_time) .. ago(detection_time))
    | extend Message = tostring(split(OriginalObjectId, " ")[0])
    | where Message =~ "RetrieveMultiple"
    | extend numQueryCount = todouble(QueryResults)
    | extend QueryCount = iif(QueryResults contains ',', todouble(countof(tostring(QueryResults), ",") + 1), numQueryCount)
    | extend QueryCount = iif(isnotempty(QueryCount), QueryCount, double(1))
    | summarize HistoricalBaseline = sum(QueryCount) by UserId;

// Current activity in the last day
let current =
    Dynamics365Activity
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(detection_time)
    | extend Message = tostring(split(OriginalObjectId, " ")[0])
    | where Message =~ "RetrieveMultiple"
    | extend numQueryCount = todouble(QueryResults)
    | extend QueryCount = iif(QueryResults contains ',', todouble(countof(tostring(QueryResults), ",") + 1), numQueryCount)
    | extend QueryCount = iif(isnotempty(QueryCount), QueryCount, double(1))
    | summarize CurrentExportRate = sum(QueryCount) by UserId;

// Compare current vs. baseline; include users with no history using a default baseline
baseline
| join kind=rightouter current on UserId
| extend HistoricalBaseline = iif(isnotnull(HistoricalBaseline), HistoricalBaseline, defaultBaseline)
| where CurrentExportRate > HistoricalBaseline
| join kind=inner (
    Dynamics365Activity
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(detection_time)
    | extend Message = tostring(split(OriginalObjectId, " ")[0])
    | where Message =~ "RetrieveMultiple"
    | extend numQueryCount = todouble(QueryResults)
    | extend QueryCount = iif(QueryResults contains ',', todouble(countof(tostring(QueryResults), ",") + 1), numQueryCount)
    | extend QueryCount = iif(isnotempty(QueryCount), QueryCount, double(1))
  ) on UserId
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    UserId,
    QueryCount,
    UserAgent,
    Message,
    ClientIP,
    HistoricalBaseline,
    CurrentExportRate,
    CorrelationId,
    CrmOrganizationUniqueName
| summarize
    QuerySizes = make_set(QueryCount),
    MostRecentQuery = max(TimeGenerated),
    IPs = make_set(ClientIP),
    UserAgents = make_set(UserAgent)
    by UserId, CrmOrganizationUniqueName, HistoricalBaseline, CurrentExportRate

    AccountName = tostring(split(UserId, "@")[0]),

properties.displayName: [Persistence] Authentication Methods Changed for Privileged User(s)
properties.description:
Identifies authentication methods being changed for a privileged account. This could indicate an attacker
adding or modifying an auth method to maintain access.
Ref: https://docs.microsoft.com/azure/active-directory/fundamentals/security-operations-privileged-accounts#things-to-monitor-1
properties.query:
// Parameters
let identityinfo_window = 14d;
let lookback = 2h;
let security_info_actions = dynamic([
  "User registered security info",
  "User changed default security info",
  "User deleted security info",
  "Admin updated security info",
  "User reviewed security info",
  "Admin deleted security info",
  "Admin registered security info"
]);

// Build VIP list (privileged identities) from IdentityInfo
let VIPUsers =
  IdentityInfo
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(identityinfo_window)
  | mv-expand AssignedRoles
  | where tostring(AssignedRoles) contains 'Admin'   // tune to exact role names if needed
  | summarize by AccountUPN;

// Main query: authentication method changes in the last 2 hours
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where Category =~ "UserManagement"
| where ActivityDisplayName in (security_info_actions)
// Initiator (app or user)
| extend InitiatingAppName               = tostring(InitiatedBy.app.displayName)
| extend InitiatingAppServicePrincipalId = tostring(InitiatedBy.app.servicePrincipalId)
| extend InitiatingUserPrincipalName     = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName)
| extend InitiatingAadUserId             = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.id)
| extend InitiatingIpAddress             = tostring(iff(isnotempty(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress), InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress, InitiatedBy.app.ipAddress))
// Extract target user from TargetResources
| mv-apply TargetResource = TargetResources on
  (
    where TargetResource.type =~ "User"
    | extend TargetUserPrincipalName = tostring(TargetResource.userPrincipalName),
             TargetAadUserId         = tostring(TargetResource.id)
  )
// Keep only privileged targets by joining with VIPUsers
| join kind=innerunique (VIPUsers) on $left.TargetUserPrincipalName == $right.AccountUPN
// Split UPNs for entity mapping
| extend InitiatingAccountName      = tostring(split(InitiatingUserPrincipalName, "@")[0])
| extend InitiatingAccountUPNSuffix = iif(array_length(split(InitiatingUserPrincipalName, "@")) >= 2, tostring(split(InitiatingUserPrincipalName, "@")[1]), "")
| extend TargetAccountName          = tostring(split(TargetUserPrincipalName, "@")[0])
| extend TargetAccountUPNSuffix     = iif(array_length(split(TargetUserPrincipalName, "@")) >= 2, tostring(split(TargetUserPrincipalName, "@")[1]), "")
// Output columns
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    ActivityDisplayName,
    Result,
    ResultReason,
    InitiatingAppName,
    InitiatingAppServicePrincipalId,
    InitiatingUserPrincipalName,
    InitiatingAadUserId,
    InitiatingIpAddress,
    TargetUserPrincipalName,
    TargetAadUserId,
    InitiatingAccountName,
    InitiatingAccountUPNSuffix,
    TargetAccountName,
    TargetAccountUPNSuffix

properties.displayName: Indicator Removal Activity Detected
properties.description:
This alert detects attempts to remove indicators of compromise (IOCs) from a system, such as clearing event logs or deleting forensic artifacts. These actions are commonly used by attackers to evade detection and hinder incident response efforts. This behavior is highly suspicious and should be investigated immediately.

Investigate the user and process responsible for the activity.
Review recent alerts or suspicious behavior on the same device
properties.query:
DeviceFileEvents
| where ActionType == "FileDeleted"
| where FileName endswith ".log"
       or FileName endswith ".json"
       or FileName endswith ".evtx"
       or FileName endswith ".txt"
       or FileName endswith ".etl"         // Event Trace Log
       or FileName endswith ".csv"
       or FileName endswith ".xml"
| where FolderPath has_any (
    @"\Windows\System32\winevt\Logs",                  // Windows Event Logs
    @"\Windows\System32\LogFiles",                    // IIS / diagnostic logs
    @"\Windows\System32\config",                      // Registry hives
    @"\AppData\Local\Temp",                           // Temp artifacts
    @"\AppData\Roaming",                              // User-level artifacts
    @"\ProgramData",                                  // App-level logs
    @"\$Recycle.Bin",                                 // Recycle Bin
    @"\Users\Public",                                 // Shared data
    @"\AppData\Local\Microsoft\Windows\WebCache",     // Web/Edge cache
    @"\NTUSER.DAT",                                   // User registry hive
    @"\SAM",                                          // SAM database
    @"\System32\Tasks"                                // Scheduled tasks
)
| extend LowerFolderPath = tolower(FolderPath)
| where not(LowerFolderPath has_any ("tempinstalls", "cache"))
| project TimeGenerated,
          DeviceName,
          InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          FileName,
          FolderPath,
          InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
